errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there are two models; the figure shows six distinct models/configurations (mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, XLM-B₂). The positions L2, R2, B2 are not separate from the models but part of their naming.

The description incorrectly maps colors to models. mBERT bars are not all red, and XLM bars are not all blue. The colors are: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), XLM-B₂ (red).
The y-axis range in the figure extends to 40, not 35.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the effect of different models/configurations on language families, which is mentioned in the reference.
The description omits the units or scale type of the y-axis (linear scale with intervals of 5) and does not mention the full set of language families (e.g., IE-other, Isolate).
The description fails to mention the legend, which is present in the top right of the figure and critical for interpreting the colors and models.
The description does not specify the six distinct models/configurations (mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, XLM-B₂) or their exact color mappings.
The description omits the approximate values for specific groups (e.g., IE-Indic ranges from 17 to 23, Uralic mostly below 5) mentioned in the reference.
The description does not mention the variability in error bars, particularly the larger error bars for the Semitic group.
